name: distribb
title_zh: 从选词到回评，一条流水线跑完的 SEO 后台
tagline_zh: 关键词、原创数据、WordPress 发布、外链交换、内链、社媒改写。
tagline_en: Keywords, original data, WordPress publishing, backlink swaps, internal links, social repurposing, Google.
desc_en: Distribb is an SEO platform that handles keyword research, original data research, content publishing to WordPress/Webflow/Shopify, high-DR backlink exchange network, link building outreach playbooks, internal linking, social media repurposing and posting, Google Business Profile management (live reviews, public review replies, Google posts), and Microworkers campaign management. Use this skill wh
why_zh: 它把「研究—发布—外链—回评」当成一条有状态的流水线，而不是一堆孤立按钮。
why_en: It treats research, publishing, link building and review replies as one stateful pipeline, so each step's output feeds the next.
limit_zh: 它是 Distribb 平台的客户端，没有账号和 API key 就一步都跑不动。
limit_en: Requires a Distribb account and API key — nothing runs without them. Publishing covers only WordPress/Webflow/Shopify; other CMSs need manual.
title_en: One SEO pipeline from keyword to review reply
